title: 信息日报 2026-09-13

headline.title: 习近平在新德里获红毯礼遇，中印关系显露缓和
headline.summary: 中国国家主席习近平抵达新德里出席金砖国家峰会，受到红毯欢迎。报道称，中印这对地区竞争对手在公开场合展示关系缓和，同时在动荡的美国因素之下暗自争夺地区领导权。此行被视为2020年致命边境冲突之后两国关系继续解冻的一步。
headline.title_en: Xi Jinping gets red carpet at Brics summit amid thaw in India-China relations
headline.summary_en: Chinese President Xi Jinping received a red-carpet welcome in New Delhi for a summit of Brics developing nations, as regional rivals Beijing and Delhi made a public display of thawing relations while quietly competing to lead at a time of shaky US leadership. The arrival is seen as a step towards reconciliation after the deadly 2020 military clash between the two countries.
headline.original_title: Xi Jinping gets red carpet at Brics summit amid thaw in India-China relations
headline.reason: 金砖新德里峰会与习近平—莫迪会晤是当日最具全局影响的事件：它牵动中印关系走向、新兴经济体在关税与制裁问题上的联合立场，并与财经理财版面的能源通胀、美国—中国竞争议题直接呼应，值得作为头条优先阅读。
headline.reason_en: The Brics summit in New Delhi and the Xi–Modi meeting were the day's most consequential story: they shape India–China relations and the emerging-power front on tariffs and sanctions, and connect directly to the finance desk's coverage of energy-driven inflation and US–China rivalry.
